ALRITEALREADY! — live, scroll inside this artboard
ALREADY! is fixed and never moves. Scroll to cycle ALRITE -> BEEN -> SEEN -> SPREAD -> ALRITE, loops both directions. Plain, no scroll cue, no dots. Red/black is a placeholder scheme.

Mobile — live, scroll or swipe inside this artboard
Every letter of the phrase stacked one per line. ALREADY! is the fixed bottom letters; the word above it (bottom-aligned so it always meets ALREADY!) cycles on scroll/swipe, loops.
Earlier explorations (not pursued) — kept for reference, not part of the current direction.
